narrative: 这个镜头是一页反抗的纸。保持人物清晰可辨。
让墨去施展暴力：一团晕开的墨越过脸颊，一片飞溅遮住了门口，一片黑潮还没漫到眼睛。片头字幕、音乐段落，以及一个内心一团糟的角色，都能承受这个风格。
程序化的犯罪题材拍摄通常承受不了，除非是在片尾字幕里。当你需要清晰的空间关系、视线方向，或一个干净的插入镜头时，它就是错误的工具。
如果脸被淹没了，你拍的只是一段现成的颜料循环素材，而不是一场戏。
how: 固定机位，或使用一种不会追逐每一处飞溅的极轻微手持。平视高度，35mm到50mm焦段，主体保持清晰。
主光来自一盏真实的灯（钠灯、窗光、实景灯），让这个被拍摄的身体拥有阴影。把墨描述成一种物质：晕开、滴落、占据空气。
只用一套色板，而不是所有色相。保持眼睛清晰。
提示词：Prompt: Ink riot around [Subject], black and color blooming in liquid, calligraphy as explosion, a page that fights.
when: 一张片头字幕卡、一次崩溃、一个房间应该溢出的音乐静帧。不要用在需要靠对话来剪切的双人镜头上。
vs: 拼贴（Collage）是剪切的纸张和边缘，是干燥的碎片，而不是液体。混合媒介（Mixed Media）则是把不同的质感和技法叠加在一起。
丙烯画风（Akrill）是覆盖在世界之上的厚重颜料。泼墨特效则是悬浮在空气中的书法，围绕着一张依然保持照片质感的脸。
examples_film: 张艺谋的《英雄》把水中的墨当作围绕身体的天气来使用。《罪恶之城》（Sin City）的片头把墨本身当作整个世界。
静帧应该看起来是湿润的。你借鉴的是液体的法则，而不是某一帧画面。
mistakes: 生成模型把主体淹没，或同时加上了漫画风的网点和油画质感。破绽是看不到眼睛，或一个画面里塞满了所有媒介。
修正方法：单一的墨色色板、保持摄影质感的脸、固定机位，以及把墨当作空气中的一种物质。

faq.q: 电影中的泼墨特效（Ink Riot）是什么？
faq.a: 一种图形化的风格，墨在这里表现得像围绕着摄影主体的天气：晕开、滴落的书法。摄影机依然有一个固定的支点。脸依然必须清晰可辨。

faq.q: 泼墨特效（Ink Riot）与拼贴（Collage）的区别
faq.a: 拼贴是带有干燥边缘的剪切碎片。泼墨特效则是悬浮在空气中的液体。如果你能把画面中的某一层剥离下来，你想要的是拼贴；如果画面应该看起来是湿的，你想要的是这个风格。

faq.q: 什么时候该用泼墨特效？
faq.a: 片头字幕、音乐段落、一个内心正在溢出的角色。对于程序化的题材拍摄，以及任何需要干净视线方向的节拍，跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写泼墨特效的提示词？
faq.a: 先说明人物、锁定摄影机、说明主光，然后保持眼睛清晰。只用一套墨色色板。

narrative: The shot is a page that fought back. Hold the person.

Let ink do the violence: a bloom past the cheek, a splash that hides a doorway, a black tide that has not yet reached the eyes. Titles, music, and a character whose interior is a mess can survive this.
Procedural crime coverage usually cannot, unless you are in the credits. It is the wrong tool when you need geography, eyelines, or a clean insert.
If the face drowns, you shot a stock loop of paint, not a scene.
how: Lock off, or use a tiny handheld that does not chase every splash. Eye height, 35mm to 50mm, subject sharp.
Key is a real lamp (sodium, window, practical) so the photographic body has a shadow. Describe ink as matter: blooming, dripping, occupying air.
One palette, not every hue. Keep eyes clear.
Prompt: Ink riot around [Subject], black and color blooming in liquid, calligraphy as explosion, a page that fights.
when: A title card, a breakdown, a music still where the room should spill. Do not use it on a two-shot that has to cut on dialogue.
vs: Collage is cut paper and edges, dry pieces, not liquid. Mixed Media stacks stocks and techniques.
Akrill is thick paint sitting on the world. Ink riot is airborne calligraphy around a face that still photographs.
examples_film: Zhang Yimou's Hero uses ink-in-water as weather around bodies. Sin City titles treat ink as the world.
The still should look wet. You are borrowing the liquid law, not a frame.
mistakes: Models drown the subject or add Comic halftone and oil at once. The tell is no eyes, or every medium in one frame.
Fix it: one ink palette, photographic face, lock-off, ink as matter in air.

faq.q: What is Ink Riot in film?
faq.a: A graphic look where ink behaves as weather around a photographic subject: blooming, dripping calligraphy. The camera still has a stand. The face still has to read.
Collage is cut pieces with dry edges. Ink riot is liquid in air. If you can peel a layer off the frame, you wanted collage. If it should look wet, you wanted this.

faq.q: When should I use Ink Riot?
faq.a: Titles, music, a character whose interior spills. Skip it for procedural coverage and any beat that needs a clean eyeline.

faq.q: How do I prompt Ink Riot for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the person, lock the camera, name the key, then: Ink riot around [Subject], black and color blooming in liquid, calligraphy as explosion, a page that fights. Keep the eyes. One ink palette.
